ctx.x: People have said you sounded a lot like Charlie Christian.

He was a big influence. Because the things that he played I had in mind to play a long time. That's the way I wanted -- before I even heard him. It wasn't a matter of copying. It was a matter of -- I'd have to associate it with Ross Columbo and Bing Crosby. They both sounded alike. So it wasn't a matter of somebody copying somebody. --- A lot of people sound alike. Just like a lot of people fares no kin, but they look alike -- look like they come from the same family. So, it wasn't a matter of me copying, I mean…
Radio broadcast for Philco Hall of fame on NBC in 1944 in New York
